row.evidence: Proposify's pricing page lists 'SSO (Okta, Azure, Salesforce)' on Enterprise, and its SSO guide covers OIDC/Salesforce sign-in only, noting that user provisioning is 'coming soon'; no SCIM endpoint appears in the help centre or the Connect API reference.
row.notes: No SCIM on any plan (none by absence, rule 5). SSO is OIDC for Okta and Azure (SAML with Azure is explicitly unsupported) plus a Salesforce connected app, and needs a branded subdomain; the Salesforce guide lists user provisioning as 'coming soon'. Pricing page (annual): Team $35/user/mo ($420/user/year; $49 monthly), Business $325/mo for 5 seats, Enterprise $1,066/mo for 10 seats, extra seats $780/year on both; Business and Enterprise are flat-plus-seat pricing so per-user fields stay null. SSO sits on Enterprise per the pricing page, but the help centre's SSO guide and plans article (older, with Basic $29, Team $49, Business $65) put SSO on Business; pricing page used. The Connect API (OAuth2, API Access on Business) only lists users (GET /user); no create, deactivate or role endpoints. Okta's catalogue app is SWA only.

webhooks_user_events.notes: Webhook events are document events only (document.created … document.commented).

limitations.text: Users API is read-only: only GET /user (list account users) is documented.

okta.notes: Catalogue app is SWA only (SAML, OIDC and SCIM not ticked). Proposify documents its own Okta OIDC setup.

entra.notes: No Proposify app in the Entra saas-apps tutorial list; Proposify documents a manual Azure app registration with OIDC.
